title: laug · cell
description: One Temporal cell's server: identity, the front door without long polls, errors two ways, matching, history's queues, shards, persistence, workflows, bucket edges and the SDK side. Nothing in its queries is laug's but one scope: pick the Prometheus, the label that names a cell in it, and the cell. Its rows that read load/steady-state.yaml's queries keep them as written, the scope added. No panel is ported from temporalio/dashboards (MIT, Copyright 2025 Temporal Technologies); the queries are written from the server's metric names. Times are UTC.

panels.title: Frontend latency, long polls excluded: p99 and p50 (ms)
panels.description: p99 is load/steady-state.yaml's frontend query with the scope added, 1 m rolling; p50 the same at 0.5. Long polls are left out because the server holds them up to 60 s when there is no work: on an idle laug cell p99 read 98 862 ms with them and 20 ms without (docs/DESIGN.md section 4.2).

panels.title: Error rate, two ways (share of requests)
panels.description: Solid: load/steady-state.yaml's rate, serviceerror_Canceled left out, with the scope added. Dashed: every error. Canceled on matching's AddWorkflowTask and AddActivityTask is a sync-match miss no client sees: 447 of 467 errors on a healthy 60 s smoke run.
